apps.name: MES Radio
apps.description: Beta push-to-talk for your MES team. Talk on assigned channels and replay received voice.
apps.releaseNotes:
MES Radio 0.1.0-beta.2

Beta for MES user sign-in, assigned radio channels, push-to-talk voice and local received-voice replay.
Sign in with your MES user account. Your administrator must assign your radio channels.
Includes microphone-on-press capture, speaker volume settings and local voice history for the last 24 hours.
The radio service remains active until sign-out. Remembered sign-in details are encrypted on the device.

Android 9 or newer. Installs over the existing MES Radio Performance/beta app and preserves settings and real recordings. The package and signing certificate are unchanged.

This is a field-testing beta. Real speech between two physical devices, extended screen-off operation, network recovery and wired/Bluetooth routing still require field validation. Location and participant information depend on the deployed MES server features.

apps.name: MES Store
apps.description: Your MES apps and updates, together in one place.
apps.releaseNotes:
MES Store 1.2.14

Featured illustrations now catch a gentle shine after two seconds in view.
The light sweeps across the artwork once, then rests until you scroll away and return.
Leaving Featured, hiding the artwork or backgrounding the app cancels pending and active effects.
The effect respects Android's disabled-animation setting and keeps card text and backgrounds unchanged.

Includes MES Radio beta and its dedicated graphite-and-yellow Featured card.
Install over MES Store to preserve settings and downloads. Android 9 or newer; the package ID and release signing key are unchanged.
